Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the family leave insurance program.

BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 51.44.033 and 2007 c 357 s 23 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There shall be, in the office of the state treasurer, a fund to beknown and designated as the "supplemental pension fund". The directorshall be the administrator thereof. The fund shall be used for the HB 1160 p. 2 sole purposes of making the additional payments therefrom prescribed inthis title ((and the loans therefrom authorized in RCW 49.86.190)).
